description:
Advanced multi-source music streaming + discovery client for desktop. Free, clean, no login, no ads.

muffon is a cross-platform music streaming client for desktop, which helps you listen to, discover and organize music in an advanced way.
It retrieves audio, video and metadata from various Internet sources, such as:
- Last.FM
- VK
- Odnoklassniki
- Yandex Music
- Spotify
- Bandcamp
- Deezer
- SoundCloud
- YouTube Music
- YouTube
- Discogs
- Genius
- MusixMatch
- MusicBrainz
Features
- Add Amazon Music source
- Add Audius source
- Bring back Deezer source
- Add recommendations radio
- Add multitag tracks
Languages
- Add Indonesian language (@flessan)
- Add Vietnamese language (@hoang0109)
Changes / Improvements
- Add YouTube Music as a source for artists’ albums
- Add recommendations count to artist info popup
- Add order change on multitag page
- Change albums types for Spotify source on artist’s albums page
- Add views counters to videos' lists
- Add duration to videos' lists
- Add duration to queue tracks list
- Add logic for changing volume by mouse wheel scroll
- Improve track's Discord Rich Presence on playing / paused states
- Add counters to tabs on profile / favorites / bookmarks / community pages
- Add icons to tabs
- Add logic for disabling back / forward navigation buttons if can't go back / forward
- Change sources’ icons
- Rename Odnoklassniki to OK.ru
- Add sources’ icons to tracks in player's variants list
- Add "Focus on current video" option
- Use official countries names
- Minor UI changes
Fixes
- Fix bug with infinite scroll not working on “Saved tracks” page
- Fix MusixMatch source not working
- Fix bug when post’s / comment’s attached album’s source icon had wrong color
- Fix bug when lists' pagination section was visible when only 1 page was available
- Fix bug when tab scale was reset on focus
- Fix bug when tab hasn't been focused on tabs switch
- Fix bug when wrong tab has been focused on window focus
- Fix bug when country select fields had wrong countries’ order for some languages
- Fix bug when segments' tabs weren't focused on content load
- Fix bug when current track wasn't highlighted sometimes
- Fix bug when form's error messages' text wasn't changed on language change
- Fix bug when some deeplinks returned “Page not found”
- Fix bug when YouTube videos weren’t playing
- Minor UI bugs’ fixes
